vulnerability.name: USN-5749-1
vulnerability.description: Erik de Castro Lopo and Agostino Sarubbo discovered that libsamplerate did not properly perform bounds checking. If a user were tricked into processing a specially crafted audio file, an attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a crash.

statements.status_notes: libsamplerate could cause a crash if it processed a specially crafted audio file. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
